html:
Note to self : The plain dark leather of the journal cover finally wore me down.. Manuel and I came up with the idea of a ‘dashboard’ that can be changed as needed.

A5 : I used an old pencil board I had made but didn’t want to trash because it’s my artwork. I cut it down and rounded the corners. The back is blank but I am thinking on what would be useful.

B6 : In discussing with Manuel what COULD be useful on the back of the A5, we ended up with this general design. I spent the afternoon perfecting it until I got what I wanted.

This one in particular gets carried a lot, so the dashboard is ready to be printed again if needed.

Passport TN : In progress, the band is made.. the dashboard is not functional but it will be a helluva memory lol.

Supplies Used : A5 Stalogy, B6 Stalogy, Derwent Inktense Watercolor, Posca, India Ink, ArtStudio Pro, Procreate, Canva
